name: Stateside Dance AI: Do the Viral Stateside Trend From One Photo
blurb: The Stateside dance is the TikTok routine to PinkPantheress and Zara Larsson's "Stateside": hands on the head, hip pops, a kick and a big arm raise, all on the "boots, that's my ego boost" line.

prompts.label: 1. The video prompt is filled in. Settings: Seedance 2.5, 14 s, 720p, 9:16, sound off. The video prompt
prompts.text:
Recreate the reference video [Video 1] shot for shot: the same bright room with the white arched doorway, the warm wooden floor and the plants, the same fixed phone camera at chest height, the same framing from head to shoes, the same timing and the same dance moves, one continuous shot. The ONLY change: the dancer in the baseball cap, white T-shirt and wide light-blue jeans is now the person in [Image 1].

The dancer = the person in [Image 1], in EVERY frame: copy the exact face from [Image 1]: the face shape, eye color and eye shape, eyebrows, nose, mouth, skin tone, age, hair color, hair length and hairstyle, and any beard, moustache, glasses or freckles exactly as in the photo. The dancer in the baseball cap becomes the person in [Image 1], looking exactly as in [Image 1] in every shot, including every turn, every kick and every moment the face comes close, and never wearing the cap, the white T-shirt or the wide jeans from the video unless [Image 1] shows them. The dancer wears the clothes from [Image 1]; if [Image 1] shows only the head or the upper body, invent the rest so it matches naturally. A real, photorealistic person, with no team name or number on their clothes. The same real person in every frame, from the first second to the last, so their friends instantly recognize them. Never morph, never drift back to the original dancer's face. NO cap and NO hat unless [Image 1] shows one. NO moustache unless [Image 1] shows one. No tattoos unless [Image 1] shows them.

Keep every movement, every step of the dance, every lip movement, every camera move and the timing exactly as in [Video 1]. The dance, matching the reference second by second, on the beat:
0-1 s: faces the camera, a small bounce, hands at the chest.
1-2.5 s: steps to the side with one arm swinging out, a quarter turn.
2.5-3 s: a quick step out and a kick back.
3-4.5 s: both hands on top of the head, then elbows out and a hip pop.
4.5-7 s: hand flicks by the face and shoulder bounces, stepping on the beat.
7-8.5 s: one hand to the head, then the other arm raised high.
8.5-10 s: a knee lift and a kick, then the arms open wide.
10-12.5 s: steps and shoulder rolls, hands near the chest.
12.5-14 s: one arm raised high above the head for the finish.
Do not invent additional moves. Keep the room unchanged. Keep the face clearly lit.

Anatomy rules: one head only, on the dancer's shoulders. A face never appears on knees, legs, hands or clothes. Two arms, two hands, five fingers on each hand. Exactly one person. Natural balance, stable ground contact. No text, captions, logos or watermark. No dialogue throughout the entire video. No background music.

prompts.label: 1. The video prompt is filled in. Settings: Seedance 2.5, 15 s, 720p, 9:16, sound off. The video prompt
prompts.text:
Recreate the reference video [Video 1] shot for shot: the same plain light grey studio with the soft shadow on the floor, the same fixed camera, framing, timing and dance moves, one continuous shot. The ONLY change: the puppy who dances upright on its hind legs is now the pet in [Image 1].

The dancer = the pet in [Image 1], whole body, in every frame: the same species and breed, head shape, muzzle, eyes, ears, fur colors, fur length, markings and body shape as in [Image 1], with the natural body volume and proportions of that animal: never flattened, squashed, stretched or merged with anything, so its owner instantly recognizes it, also in the close moments. It keeps its own real look from [Image 1], with real fur, never a cartoon puppy. Never drift back to the puppy of the original video: not the coat of the puppy in the video, no golden fluffy fur unless [Image 1] shows it. It stands upright on its hind legs like a person the whole time, and its mouth opens and closes as in [Video 1]. If [Image 1] shows a cat or another animal, that animal dances in the same place with the same moves.

Keep every movement, every step of the dance and the timing exactly as in [Video 1]. The dance, matching the reference second by second, on the beat:
0-1 s: faces the camera, front paws by its cheeks, mouth open as if singing.
1-2 s: a quick turn to the side and back.
2-4 s: little hops with the front paws up by its head, then at its chest.
4-5.5 s: a wide stance, front paws out, then one paw to its face.
5.5-7.5 s: leans and hops to the side, turning side-on.
7.5-9 s: one front paw raised high, a turn away and back.
9-12 s: sways and leans with the front paws crossed at its chest.
12-15 s: one front paw raised high above its head, then both paws by its face to the end.
Do not invent additional moves. Keep the studio unchanged.

Anatomy rules: one head only, one tail. Two hind legs on the floor and two front legs, no extra legs or paws, no human hands. Natural balance, stable ground contact. No text, no logos, no watermark, no people, no extra animals. No dialogue throughout the entire video. No background music.
